doi.title: Doi
doi.description: Digital Object Identifier for the document.

url.title: Url
url.description: Consensus URL for more paper details.

semantic_score.title: Semantic Score
semantic_score.description: Semantic relevance score for the paper. Only returned when include_semantic_score is true. The score is only returned for the top 50 results; it is omitted for all later results.

citation_count.title: Citation Count
citation_count.description: Number of citations for the paper.

takeaway.title: Takeaway
takeaway.description: Key takeaway or summary from the paper abstract.

full_text_chunks.title: Full Text Chunks
full_text_chunks.description: Query-relevant paper excerpts, returned only when requested.

sjr_best_quartile.title: Sjr Best Quartile
sjr_best_quartile.description: SCImago Journal Rank best quartile for the journal (1 = top, 4 = bottom).

sample_size.title: Sample Size
sample_size.description: Number of participants or subjects in the study, when known.

study_count.title: Study Count
study_count.description: Number of studies synthesized (e.g. for a meta-analysis), when known.

is_preprint.title: Is Preprint
is_preprint.description: True when the paper is a preprint (not yet peer-reviewed).

countries_of_study.title: Countries Of Study
countries_of_study.description: Countries where the study was conducted, when known.

study_duration_days.title: Study Duration Days
study_duration_days.description: Study duration in days, when known.

influential_citation_count.title: Influential Citation Count
influential_citation_count.description: Number of influential citations (from Semantic Scholar).

page_size.title: Page Size
page_size.description: Number of results per page actually applied to this response.

is_end.title: Is End
is_end.description: True when no further page is indicated by the search backend.

next_page.title: Next Page
next_page.description: Next zero-indexed page to request, if one is available.

StudyTypeKeywordEnum.description: All possible study types strings saved to search index documents.
